summary: Iteration 26 — Stripe SaaS checkout + read-only paywall. Backend: 12/13 pytest GREEN. Frontend: all critical selectors present on /billing, sidebar decomposition non-regressed, read-only banner + 402 toast working. Confirmed ConfirmDialog opens on plan-select-entreprise and redirects to checkout.stripe.com successfully. NOT completed: full Stripe form fill on checkout.stripe.com (would mutate Stripe test data + org plan; spec asked to reset with mongo after, so I intentionally did not go past redirect — the plan on BEVID Démo remains 'pro' as before, no cleanup needed). One CRITICAL bug found: POST /api/payments/checkout is intercepted by BillingGuardMiddleware for read_only orgs (returns 402) — this contradicts the spec which requires the endpoint to remain reachable so a read_only owner can pay to reactivate. billing_guard.EXEMPT_PATH_PATTERNS lacks '/api/payments'.

critical.issue: BillingGuardMiddleware returns 402 for read_only orgs. Spec (and comment in billing_guard.py L11-31) requires this endpoint to be EXEMPT so the owner of a read_only org can pay to reactivate. Currently readonly.test@bevidcrm.fr cannot checkout — infinite lockout. Fix: add re.compile(r'^/api/payments(/|$)') (or at minimum '^/api/payments/checkout') to EXEMPT_PATH_PATTERNS in /app/backend/billing_guard.py. Note the module header already lists /api/payments among the paths that 'should' pass but the regex list is missing it.

ui_bugs.issue: The RGPD 'Statistiques anonymes ?' banner (Accepter/Refuser) sits above content and can intercept clicks on plan-select buttons (first run required a dismiss to open ConfirmDialog). Not a blocker but consider raising ConfirmDialog z-index over the consent banner or auto-hiding the banner on /billing.

issues: CSP blocks https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js and https://ap.emergent.sh/flags — repeated console errors on every page. Non-functional but noisy (already flagged in iter25).

rca_of_the_issue: billing_guard.BillingGuardMiddleware.EXEMPT_PATH_PATTERNS list omits '/api/payments' — while its docstring (L11 and L30-31) explicitly says a read_only client must be able to 'payer'. Root cause: exemption list was hand-curated and /api/payments was overlooked (only /api/billing + /api/stripe + /api/webhook* were added). Reproduction: login readonly.test → POST /api/payments/checkout {lookup_key:'bevid_pro_monthly', origin_url:X} → 402 billing_blocked. Expected 200 with checkout_url. Mitigation: add re.compile(r'^/api/payments(/|$)') to EXEMPT_PATH_PATTERNS (line ~32 of /app/backend/billing_guard.py). All /api/payments/* endpoints already require auth + ownership at the route level (checkout is @owner_required), so exempting the whole prefix is safe.
